description: Lists what a domain declares agents can do (OpenAPI operations, MCP tools, A2A skills, API catalog entries), each classed by safety, which ones CrawlCheck called and confirmed, and every mismatch. Read from the latest scan on file; run scan_domain first if there is none. Use before relying on a site's declared actions. For a remote MCP endpoint's status use mcp_servers.
